name: european_carriers_return
title: European carriers stay away after their announced return dates (24-25 Oct 2026): the value of their return is minus this
notes: The normal world has these carriers flying all winter (last year's schedule). In 2026 they suspended Abu Dhabi during the war; Wego (4 Sep 2026, updated 4 Sep) reports Lufthansa Group and Wizz Air expected back on 24 Oct and British Airways on 25 Oct. Dates are provisional.
Lufthansa Group at AUH in the data = Eurowings (Berlin); Wizz Air = Katowice and Krakow; British Airways = London.

Each change cancels the carrier's routes from its return date to the end of the horizon: the result is what Abu Dhabi would lose if they did not come back; their return is worth the same amount with the sign reversed.

changes.source: Wego 4 Sep 2026 (Lufthansa Group expected 24 Oct, provisional)
Wego 4 Sep 2026 (Wizz Air expected 24 Oct, provisional)
Wego 4 Sep 2026 (British Airways expected 25 Oct, provisional)
